snippet.title: Bellum - Official Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
Bellum is a realistic PvP FPS with an emphasis on authentic gunplay, platoon-scale strategic planning, and squad-level tactical execution. Meticulously designed to create intense firefights where success hinges on the players' ability to apply real-world tactics and coordinate as a team.

💻Learn More ► https://playbellum.com/
🔊Join Our Discord ► https://discord.gg/playbellum
